description: Read-only tools for the Rubric Dashboard. Call these over GET with query params; require same-origin auth (session). Base URL: your app origin (e.g. https://your-app.vercel.app or http://localhost:3000).

function.name: get_risk_summary
function.description: Get risk summary for the rubric dashboard: total developers, at-risk count, percentage at risk, and breakdown by flag (lowScore, declining, stagnant, dataGap). Use for questions like 'How many developers are at risk?' or 'What is Scott's portfolio risk?'

quarter.description: Quarter key, e.g. 2025-Q2. Optional; defaults to latest quarter.

coach.description: Coach name for portfolio-level risk (e.g. 'Scott Rust'). Admin only; omit for org-wide.

function.name: get_subject_distribution
function.description: Get one person's (subject's) evaluation distribution for a quarter: scores 1-4 per dimension (Tech Mastery, Build Trust, Resilient Under Pressure, Team Player, Move Fast), at-risk flag, and risk flags. Use for questions like 'How did Ruvi Raghavan do this quarter?' or 'What are the scores for [name]?'

subject.description: Full name of the person (consultant) as in the system, e.g. 'Ruvi Raghavan'.

quarter.description: Quarter key, e.g. 2025-Q2. Optional; defaults to latest quarter.
